description: This file handles AJAX requests for the Calendar module in the vtiger CRM system, including rendering different calendar views, updating activity statuses, and fetching event and to-do lists.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Represents calendar views (day, week, month, year) and manages activity addition and date slicing.

methods.name: calendar_layout
methods.description: Renders the calendar layout with activities.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language strings for the specified module.

methods.name: getEventList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events within a date range.

methods.name: constructEventListView
methods.description: Constructs HTML view for event list.

methods.name: getTodoList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of to-do items within a date range.

methods.name: constructTodoListView
methods.description: Constructs HTML view for to-do list.

methods.name: getTodoInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about to-do items.

methods.name: checkFileAccessForInclusion
methods.description: Checks security and access rights for including files.
